value.rationale: Optimal-solution multiplicity is the natural k-valued refinement of forest minimum-total-domination counts; a single uniform arm subdivision from length 3 to length 4 produces a sharp exponential versus polynomial number of minimizers at fixed k. The closed formulas identify complete optimal families for infinitely many noncaterpillar trees and arbitrary multicover demand. This is not a mere scalar numerical optimization or cosmetic variant; it describes flexibility and growth of all optima.
